## Planification stratégique et occasions locales

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(plotly)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)

cases <- tribble(
  ~id, ~case, ~x, ~y, ~region, ~trajectory,
   1, "Paris — Plan Vélo",                 2.0, 9.1, "Europe", "Transition programmée",
   2, "Paris — coronapistes",              8.7, 8.2, "Europe", "Transition programmée",
   3, "Amsterdam — politique cyclable",    2.1, 9.2, "Europe", "Institutionnalisée",
   4, "Barcelone — superilles",            3.4, 8.4, "Europe", "Transition programmée",
   5, "Gand — plan de circulation",        2.6, 8.7, "Europe", "Institutionnalisée",
   6, "Oslo — centre-ville",               2.7, 8.6, "Europe", "Transition programmée",
   7, "Londres — Streetspace",             8.5, 7.1, "Europe", "Mixte",
   8, "Londres — LTNs",                     7.2, 6.6, "Europe", "Mixte",
   9, "Berlin — pistes temporaires",       9.1, 5.2, "Europe", "Mixte",
  10, "Lyon — coronapistes",               8.6, 6.3, "Europe", "Transition programmée",
  11, "Montréal — plan cyclable 2017",     2.7, 8.1, "Amérique du Nord", "Transition programmée",
  12, "Montréal — REV Saint-Denis",        6.5, 8.1, "Amérique du Nord", "Transition programmée",
  13, "Montréal — rues COVID",             8.8, 4.0, "Amérique du Nord", "Transition programmée",
  14, "Toronto — Cycling Network Plan",   3.5, 8.4, "Amérique du Nord", "Transition programmée",
  15, "Toronto — Bloor/Danforth",          6.9, 7.6, "Amérique du Nord", "Transition programmée",
  16, "Toronto/Hamilton — pratiques",      8.6, 7.1, "Amérique du Nord", "Non classée",
  17, "Vancouver — plan cyclable",         3.2, 7.9, "Amérique du Nord", "Transition programmée",
  18, "Vancouver — Slow Streets",          8.6, 3.5, "Amérique du Nord", "Transition programmée",
  19, "New York — Open Streets",           9.2, 4.2, "Amérique du Nord", "Non classée",
  20, "New York — Broadway",               3.8, 7.7, "Amérique du Nord", "Non classée",
  21, "Portland — réseau cyclable",        5.2, 7.6, "Amérique du Nord", "Non classée",
  22, "Seattle — Greenways",               4.2, 7.4, "Amérique du Nord", "Non classée",
  23, "San Francisco — JFK Drive",         8.3, 6.3, "Amérique du Nord", "Non classée",
  24, "Oakland — Slow Streets",            9.1, 3.4, "Amérique du Nord", "Non classée"
)

colors <- c(
  "Europe" = "#087F5B",
  "Amérique du Nord" = "#1864AB"
)

symbols <- c(
  "Institutionnalisée" = "circle",
  "Transition programmée" = "square",
  "Mixte" = "triangle-up",
  "Non classée" = "diamond-open"
)

cases <- cases %>%
  mutate(
    tooltip = paste0(
      "<b>", case, "</b>",
      "<br>Région : ", region,
      "<br>Trajectoire : ", trajectory,
      "<br>Planification : ", y, "/10",
      "<br>Occasions locales : ", x, "/10"
    )
  )

p <- plot_ly()

# Quadrant backgrounds
quadrants <- list(
  list(x0=0, x1=5, y0=5, y1=10, fill="#E0F2E9"),
  list(x0=5, x1=10, y0=5, y1=10, fill="#E3EFFB"),
  list(x0=0, x1=5, y0=0, y1=5, fill="#F1F3F5"),
  list(x0=5, x1=10, y0=0, y1=5, fill="#FFF0DF")
)

for (q in quadrants) {
  p <- p %>% layout(
    shapes = c(
      p$x$layout$shapes,
      list(list(
        type = "rect",
        x0 = q$x0, x1 = q$x1,
        y0 = q$y0, y1 = q$y1,
        fillcolor = q$fill,
        line = list(width = 0),
        layer = "below"
      ))
    )
  )
}

# One trace per region × trajectory
for (r in unique(cases$region)) {
  for (t in unique(cases$trajectory)) {

    df <- cases %>%
      filter(region == r, trajectory == t)

    if (nrow(df) == 0) next

    p <- p %>% add_trace(
      data = df,
      x = ~x,
      y = ~y,
      type = "scatter",
      mode = "markers+text",
      text = ~id,
      textposition = "middle center",
      textfont = list(color = "white", size = 10),
      hovertext = ~tooltip,
      hoverinfo = "text",
      name = paste(r, "—", t),
      marker = list(
        size = 24,
        color = colors[[r]],
        symbol = symbols[[t]],
        line = list(color = "#FFFFFF", width = 1.5)
      ),
      showlegend = TRUE
    )
  }
}

p <- p %>% layout(
  title = list(
    text = "Planification stratégique et occasions locales",
    font = list(size = 20)
  ),

  xaxis = list(
    title = "Influence des occasions locales →",
    range = c(0, 10),
    zeroline = FALSE,
    gridcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.05)"
  ),

  yaxis = list(
    title = "Rôle de la planification stratégique →",
    range = c(0, 10),
    zeroline = FALSE,
    gridcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0.05)"
  ),

  shapes = c(
    p$x$layout$shapes,
    list(
      list(type="line", x0=5, x1=5, y0=0, y1=10,
           line=list(color="#868E96", dash="dash")),
      list(type="line", x0=0, x1=10, y0=5, y1=5,
           line=list(color="#868E96", dash="dash"))
    )
  ),

  annotations = list(
    list(x=2.5, y=9.8, text="<b>Sélection stratégique</b>",
         showarrow=FALSE),
    list(x=7.5, y=9.8, text="<b>Stratégie + occasions</b>",
         showarrow=FALSE),
    list(x=2.5, y=4.5, text="<b>Sélection ponctuelle</b>",
         showarrow=FALSE),
    list(x=7.5, y=4.5, text="<b>Sélection opportuniste</b>",
         showarrow=FALSE)
  ),

  legend = list(
    orientation = "h",
    x = 0,
    y = -0.25
  ),

  paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
  plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",

  margin = list(l=70, r=30, t=70, b=110)
)

p
```
